stories.title: Former bishop Christopher Alan Saunders to be jailed for abuse spanning more than a decade

en.title: Former bishop Christopher Alan Saunders to be jailed for abuse spanning more than a decade
en.summary: A former bishop faces imprisonment for sexual abuse offences committed over an extended period. He may become the highest-ranking Catholic convicted of such crimes in Australia unless his appeal succeeds.

stories.title: Former bishop sentenced to more than six years in prison for sexually abusing young Aboriginal men

en.title: Former bishop sentenced to more than six years in prison for sexually abusing young Aboriginal men
en.summary: Christopher Alan Saunders, 76, was convicted of 13 sexual offences against two young Aboriginal men and sentenced to over six years imprisonment. He is the highest-ranked Catholic in Australia to be convicted of sexual abuse.
